evaluation_procedure_001.evidence: This article shall supersede Article 16, Evaluation, of the SFUSD/UESF contract for teachers participating in the PAR Program.

evaluation_system_002.answer: Standards-based evaluation system based on the California Standards of the Teaching Profession and the San Francisco Teaching Standards.
evaluation_system_002.evidence: Said system shall be based upon the California Standards of the Teaching Profession and may require development of appropriate evaluation forms and modification of the rating scale.
